_note: Ship wear, maintenance, refit, Warrant of Fitness and insurance (sim/condition.gd, fitness.gd, insurance.gd, ship_bill.gd and the wear, fitness and insurance systems). Every number here is a tunable; see docs/DESIGN.md 'Wear, refit, WoF and insurance'. Wear is a module's 0..1 fraction used up (condition = 1 - wear), kept apart from collision damage (ship.damage).

start._note: A stock second-hand Mule starts part-worn: wear by module kind, days in service, and a Warrant of Fitness with this many days left. The starter policy is the Commons mutual's 'basic' cover, paid for this many days.

wear._note: Wear added per hour (or per event) by what a module actually does. Drivers: hours (in service; docked hours count docked_hours_frac), burn_h (drive lit and pushing: in transit, less on approach), lit_h (reactor lit, modules with reactor_kw), thermal_h (hours lit times radiator load: heat made over heat rejected, capped), loaded_h (hours times how full the hold is), work_h (hours at a site job), dock and landing (per event). A module's own wear_mult (module_overrides) scales it. 'default' covers kinds not listed.

performance._note: Below onset condition a module's output falls linearly to max_loss at condition 0 (a mild loss: a tired drive pushes a few percent less). Only supply and rating stats are scaled (keys); capacities and loads are not.

faults._note: Small faults: below 'below' condition, each hour a module has chance rate_per_hour * ((below - c) / below)^2 of a fault that costs loss_min..loss_max of its output until it is serviced (stacking to cap per module). A warning, a few percent off; never damage and never a lost ship.

drive: the injector fouls and the drive runs rough
a coil cooling loop is running warm
radiator: a radiator panel's hinge has seized part-deployed
cargo: a pod's door seal is weeping
a latch is loose and the pod rattles
tank: a tank heater cycles too often
command: a display panel keeps dropping out

resale._note: Trade-in value of a part-worn module = price * lerp(scrap_fraction, new_fraction, condition^condition_exp) * age factor * (1 - damage). The age factor loses age_loss_per_year of value per year in service, to a floor of age_floor. A fresh module trades in near full value; a worn one for scrap.

service._note: Routine service: cheap, a little condition back (to at most cap), clears small faults. cost = basis * cost_frac, at least min_cr, times the yard's rate (jobs that would gain less than min_gain condition and clear no fault are not offered). basis is the module's price or its kind's basis_floor, whichever is higher.

overhaul._note: Overhaul: dear, near-new (to 'target' condition), clears faults, days in port. cost = basis * cost_frac * (cost_floor_mix + (1 - cost_floor_mix) * wear), at least min_cr, times the yard's rate.

refit._note: Fitting a module takes labour and days on top of the parts. Per module kind: labour_cr, days. The yard's labour rate scales the labour. crew_parallel jobs run at once, so a bundle takes max(longest job, total days / crew_parallel).

kinds._note: Per module kind: basis_floor (what a module is worth for service, overhaul, insurance when its price is 0 or low), service_days, overhaul_days, labour_cr and days (refit).

module_overrides._note: Optional per-module overrides of the kind figures: basis, service_cr, overhaul_cr, labour_cr, refit_days, service_days, overhaul_days, wear_mult.

yards._note: Yard price rates by place id (default for the rest): multipliers on service, overhaul, labour and inspection. Remote yards are dearer.

wof._note: Warrant of Fitness: a periodic safety inspection at a yard. Passes when no module is below min_condition or past max_module_damage and the keel is within max_keel_damage; otherwise it lists what must be fixed and no certificate is issued. A pass is valid valid_days. Without a valid WoF (expired, failed, or voided by a refit of refit_voids kinds): effects below. port_rules are by traffic-control class; a place's class is its own 'traffic' field or by operator (operator_class, else default_class).

insurance._note: Policies are bought at any port. Premium per period_days = insured value * plan rate * risk * claims. Insured value = keel_value + each module's basis * its resale factor. A claim for a total loss pays (insured value of the lost ship - insured value of the replacement hull) * payout_frac, less the excess, and cargo cover pays cargo_payout_frac of what the hold cost. Collision cover pays a yard repair above collision_excess_mult * the plan excess. Claims within claim_decay_days each add claim_surcharge to the premium. A void or lapsed policy pays nothing: the Commons fallback hull comes on a loan, repaid at loan_repay_cr_per_day whenever credits are above loan_keep_cr, so no pilot is ever stuck. Plans that cover collision are refused for a ship damaged beyond buy_max_damage.

standard.name: Terran Compact marine: total loss and collision repair

full.name: Lloyd's of Luna: everything, cargo too

fallback._note: No cover (none, lapsed or void): the Commons gives you a stock hull on a loan.
